Optical coupling_ The microlens principle is based on the refraction of light between the air and the lens material. Any application that requires optical glue or grease between the light source and the photodetector (e.g. LYSO crystals glued to SiPM surface) will not profit from the microlens, whereas systems where a narrow exit angle distribution of the light source is present have high potential for enhancing the PDE with MLAs.
